notes: Fastned "Model S Plaid 100 kWh" / "100 kWh (2022+)" curve (the two entries are identical), measured on a European CCS2 300-class charger, battery around 30 C, 3-91 % SoC, peak 218.2 kW at 36 % (the listed 218 kW CCS2 cap, below the 250 kW Supercharger V3 peak). Time-weighted 10-80 % takes 28.3 min at 92.3 kWh usable, which matches Out of Spec Reviews' Oct 2021 Plaid test on a V3 Supercharger (preconditioned, "a little bit over 28 minutes" 10-80 %, about 150 kW at the start, 249 kW from 8 to 33 %, under 148 kW at 50 %, under 68 kW at 80 %; as reported by InsideEVs 549335). Fastned reads 145 kW at 50 % and 64.6 kW at 80 %, so the taper agrees; the early plateau is understated by about 30 kW for a V3 session. The 5-30 % ramp is slow in the first 8 % (131 kW at 3 %). No separate Dual Motor/Long Range curve exists and Fastned gives the Plaid and 2022+ entries identical numbers; no source shows Plaid and Dual Motor charging differently. Covered range 3-91 %; outside it the viewer holds the end values. 2021 build: Fastned labels the curve "Plaid 100 kWh" and "2022+"; the 2021 Plaid and Long Range already use the 92.3 kWh pack, so assumed the same (low confidence). Pack and year match unproven: Fastned has no 2021 non-Plaid entry and our pack figures for this id are estimates. InsideEVs lists the tested 2021 Plaid at about 95 kWh usable.
